KB-01.title: Duplicate charges
KB-01.text: Duplicate card charges are reviewed by the billing team at P2. Verify the order shows more than one charge. Reversals are refunds and require human approval.

KB-02.title: Refund policy
KB-02.text: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery for damaged or defective items. Every refund must be approved by a human support lead before it is issued.

KB-03.title: Late or missing deliveries
KB-03.text: If a shipped order is more than 3 days past the carrier ETA, route to logistics at P2 so a trace can be opened with the carrier.

KB-04.title: Login and password problems
KB-04.text: Password reset problems are handled by account_security at P3. Suspected unauthorized access is always P1.

KB-05.title: Returns window
KB-05.text: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Return shipping is free for damaged items; otherwise the customer pays return shipping.

KB-06.title: Account deletion requests
KB-06.text: Account deletion is irreversible and is performed only by the privacy team after identity verification. Support agents route these tickets to account_security at P3.

KB-07.title: Checkout errors
KB-07.text: Checkout errors that block purchases are technical issues. Enterprise customers blocked from purchasing are P1; others P2.

priorities.P1: Security incident, suspected unauthorized access, or an enterprise customer fully blocked.
priorities.P2: Money is wrong (duplicate charge, refund dispute), a delivery more than 3 days late, or a non-enterprise blocking bug.
priorities.P3: Standard problem with a workaround or low financial impact.
priorities.P4: Question or information request with no problem to fix.

examples: Password reset or login trouble with no sign of someone else accessing the account -> account, P3
Sign-in alert or login the customer did not make -> account, P1
Shipped order more than 3 days past the carrier ETA -> shipping, P2
Item arrived a little late but works -> shipping, P4 (or P3 if a complaint needs follow-up)
Damaged item, customer wants a refund -> billing, P2 (the refund itself needs approval)
Enterprise customer blocked from checkout -> technical, P1
Account deletion or privacy request -> account, P3
Invoice copy or return-policy question -> general, P4
